sanskrit:
न कर्मणामनारम्भान् न्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते ।
न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥ ३-४॥
iast:
na karmaṇāmanārambhān naiṣkarmyaṃ puruṣo’śnute
na ca saṃnyasanādeva siddhiṃ samadhigacchati 3-4
translation: Not by non-performance of actions does man reach actionlessness ; nor by mere renunciation does he attain Perfection.
